assign.request: find sixty websites worth cataloguing (six per category, no two from the same company) and prove each one loads headless, recording status/ms/title/embed
steps: copy the probe script to site-scout-probe.mjs and adapt it to take a list
search each category and shortlist candidates (docs, marketing, news, blog, app, shop, system, gallery-find)
browse 3 galleries and pick 6 sites found through them
dedupe to exactly 60, assign kebab names + expected layout ids
run the probe sequentially over all 60, record status/ms/title/embed
write candidates.json sorted by category then name
write candidates.md as a one-screen table with 3 summary sentences

assumption: category counts are 8/8/8/8/8/8/6/6=60 (docs,marketing,news,blog,app,shop get 8 each; system,gallery-find get 6 each, meeting the >=6 floor) since the brief gives no exact per-category split.

risk noted before probing: amazon.com product pages and reddit.com sometimes serve a bot-check or login interstitial to headless Chromium with no stealth patches - kept in the list per the brief's rule (a failing site stays with its real status), not swapped out pre-emptively.
